subject: 'Jesus was a radical': Progressives invoke Christ to sell left-wing agenda on campaign trail
posts:
Progressive candidates are weaving faith into their campaigns, comparing their platforms to the teachings of Jesus.

Progressives Invoke Jesus
Evidence: campaign sermons, partisan pushback, faith framing
#Aletheia #USPol

Candidates argue that fighting for marginalized communities mirrors the radical social justice ministry of Jesus.
Stated Judgement: (+0.6, +0.4) — Lesser Good

Critics and conservative groups accuse candidates of selectively hijacking religious figures to launder partisan platforms.
Resulting Judgement: (-0.4, -0.5) — Lesser Evil

Verdict: FAIL — The Path of Deception.
Religious framing is weaponized for political branding, mirroring the exact tactics critics condemn.

Integrity: Conditionally Sound (Hypocrisy: 4.8, z: 2)

Sub-Audits Breakdown:
- Progressive Candidates: COND (0.2, 0.1) — Authentic faith or strategic branding.
- GOP Critics: FAIL (-0.6, -0.7) — Defending traditional religious monopoly.
Progressive Democratic candidates are increasingly incorporating religious rhetoric into their midterms messaging to challenge conservative moral majority claims.

The Bright Side:
Encourages deeper public dialogue on how personal faith informs civic duty and justice.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Confusing WHO (the political candidates) with WHY (the moral justification of their policies).

It is a classic rhetorical framing technique rather than substantive theological debate.

Social Physics Analysis:
Instead of debating policy merits directly, candidates use religious iconography as a moral shield, while opponents project ulterior motives, deepening tribal polarization.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Lesser Evil via partisan co-optation of sacred symbols.

The Unavoidable Truth: Spiritual language can powerfully inspire public service and defense of the vulnerable.

The Unavoidable Lie: political messaging faithfully represents complex theological traditions.

Alethekanon:
Sacred figures are routinely conscripted into secular partisan warfare by politicians of every stripe.

Awwthekanon:
It's beautiful when faith inspires kindness, but painful when sacred stories get chewed up in political fights.

Brothekanon:
Politicians quoting scripture to own the other side is literally the oldest trick in the political playbook.

Spirithekanon:
"Do not use your freedom to indulge the flesh; rather, serve one another humbly in love" Galatians 5:13 PASS (Spiritual Vector)
True faith is demonstrated through humble service rather than partisan posturing.
